description: Piezometri nel SIN Porto Marghera is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cigno.atlantedellalaguna.it. Stratigraphies of surveys carried out on the Site of National Interest “Venezia Porto Marghera”, relating to the reclamation plans. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Piezometers in SIN Porto Marghera" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
